# Taxi: $73 / 4 people = $18.25 each
# Dinner: $122 / 4 people = $30.50 each

taxi_share = 73 / 4
dinner_share = 122 / 4

# Request taxi fare from each roommate
for email in ['jo-harr@gmail.com', 'nan_ritt@gmail.com', 'tr_solo@gmail.com']:
    result = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=email,
        amount=taxi_share,
        access_token=venmo_token,
        description='Taxi Fare'
    )
    print(f'Taxi request to {email}: {result}')

# Pay Nancy for dinner
result = apis.venmo.create_transaction(
    receiver_email='nan_ritt@gmail.com',
    amount=dinner_share,
    access_token=venmo_token,
    description='Dinner Bill'
)
print(f'Dinner payment to Nancy: {result}')
